headline: CIN @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 4.09 at CLE 4.87, with a projected total of 8.95. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: CIN moved -0.18 runs while CLE moved -0.99, changing the projected margin by +0.81 runs. The projected total fell -1.16, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Brady Singer has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Spencer Steer, Elly De La Cruz, JJ Bleday, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nathaniel Lowe, Will Benson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
